_comment: `routes` are PUBLIC and always run. A gate that needs credentials to do
anything is a gate that dies the first time a token rotates, so the public
`authedRoutes` run ONLY when a session is available (see below). When it is
not, they are SKIPPED and reported — never failed. Otherwise every fork PR
and dependabot bump would go red for lacking a secret it cannot have.
CONTRAST_AUTH_STORAGE - JSON (or a path to a JSON file) shaped
seeded before any app code runs. Key names are not hardcoded here, so
the gate survives a change to the auth storage shape.
a dev server with devAuthBoot active, which seeds itself - which is how
this is verified locally without anyone handling a token.
`:slug` in an authed path is replaced with CONTRAST_ORG_SLUG.
`settle` is extra ms past networkidle, for pages whose intro animations land
